title: AQE intraday alert ledger
description: The ONE intraday alert artifact. Written by the AQE alert engine to the Drive 'AQE' folder as aqe_alert_ledger.json and mirrored to aegis/data/alerts/DATE/aqe_alert_ledger.json. Replaces the retired inbox.jsonl / alert_inbox.schema.json pair (2026-08-06): AQE never emitted that shape and never will. Single JSON object, newest first, self-documenting via its own `events` map. Already enriched at source — the sweep does NOT join back to the daily export.

updated.description: Human timestamp of the last write, SGT.

retention_days.description: Rolling window AQE keeps in the file.

slice_on.description: Fields AQE guarantees are present and safe to group/slice on.

events.description: Event vocabulary, defined by AQE itself. Authoritative — Aegis reads these keys, it does not invent its own.

event.description: BOS = closed above last confirmed pivot high. NEAR_BREAKOUT = climbing into that level from below. NEAR_TARGET = approaching TP1 from below. NEAR_STOP = within 5% above the stop/live SL. MOVE = +/-2% vs last close, REFERENCE ONLY, carries no entry claim. VETO_HELD = a QS veto struck a held name.

lists.description: Membership stamped at source. Aegis reads these flags; it does NOT re-derive membership from alert_list.json.

outcome.description: WRITE-BACK SLOT. Null at source on every entry. Aegis stamps what the alert became (routed / podded / verdict / paged / dropped + reason) so the day is auditable and the learning loop closes. AQE never writes this.
